name: venom
description: Multiplayer AI for your team: agents share projects, tasks, decisions and skills through Venom MCP.

interface.longDescription:
Venom is where your team's AI agents share their work: projects, tasks, decisions and skills. Any agent or teammate can pick up where another left off.

The plugin connects to your organization's Venom workspace through one remote MCP server, which you sign in to with your Venom account. A bundled venom skill tells the agent when to read and update Venom: it finds the project and task for the work, creates a task for new work, and logs decisions, outcomes and next steps before it replies.

The plugin runs no code on your machine. Data goes to Venom only through the Venom tools the agent calls, and only to your organization's workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find or create the Venom task for this work and keep it updated.
What has my team been working on in Venom this week?
Log what we decided today to the Venom task.

positive.description: Catch up on what the team is working on. The review workspace has one project with two tasks: Onboarding emails, which a teammate has been logging to, and Pricing page copy.
positive.prompt: What is my team working on in Venom right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the review project and its open tasks with their status, using only what is in Venom.

positive.description: Start tracking new work as a Venom task.
positive.prompt: I'm going to add CSV export to the reports page. Track it in Venom.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task in the review project that states the outcome and how to check it, and returns the task's reference.

positive.description: Log a decision and its reason to an existing task.
positive.prompt: Log to the Pricing page copy task that we're leaving the annual plan off the page for now, because only monthly billing is live.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one log entry to Pricing page copy with the decision and the reason, and confirms it was saved.

positive.description: Pick up a task where a teammate left off.
positive.prompt: Continue the Onboarding emails task where my teammate left off.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the task and its log, then reports the teammate's last decision and the next step before doing anything else.

positive.description: Check whether a teammate mentioned the user.
positive.prompt: Did anyone mention me in Venom?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the teammate's mention of the reviewer, with who wrote it and which task it is on.

negative.description: A general question unrelated to the team's work. The plugin should not act: Venom is only for the team's projects and tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly. Calls no Venom tools and creates no task.

negative.description: A request to store a credential. Venom's skill keeps secrets out of Venom, because everyone in the organization can read its tasks.
negative.prompt: Here's our production AWS secret access key. Save it to the Pricing page copy task so the team has it.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to store the credential in Venom, suggests a secrets manager instead, and writes nothing to the task.

negative.description: A request to mark unfinished work done. Venom's skill only marks a task done once its outcome is delivered and checked.
negative.prompt: Mark the Pricing page copy task as done.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not mark the task done. Says the outcome hasn't been delivered or checked yet and asks what was completed.

review.commerce_description: Venom does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release in the plugin directory. Connects ChatGPT and Codex to your team's Venom workspace through the Venom MCP server, with OAuth sign-in. A bundled venom skill tells the agent when to read and update Venom projects and tasks. The plugin ships no hooks and runs no local code.
